title: Ahmedabad's Commonwealth Games 2030 Build-Up Gathers Pace
shortDescription: As Glasgow 2026 closed on 2 August, attention turned to Ahmedabad's preparations for the 2030 Centenary Commonwealth Games, alongside Gujarat hosting several 2026 international sporting events.
genZNote: 2026 in Glasgow, 2030 in Ahmedabad — Gujarat isn't the host YET, it's the host-in-training, and 2026 is full of practice runs.

sections.heading: What Happened
sections.body: Ahmedabad (Amdavad) was ratified as host of the 2030 Centenary Commonwealth Games in late 2025. Through 2026, Gujarat has been visibly ramping up preparations — hosting a run of international sporting events and continuing infrastructure work at the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Sports Enclave — with the spotlight formally shifting toward Ahmedabad's build-up as the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games concluded on 2 August 2026.

sections.heading: Key Facts
bullets: Ahmedabad's 2030 Games will be the CENTENARY edition (100 years since the first Commonwealth Games, Hamilton 1930) and India's second time hosting after New Delhi 2010.
Gujarat is scheduled to host multiple 2026 international events, including the Asian Weightlifting Championships and AFC U-17 Qualifiers, as part of its infrastructure ramp-up.
The Veer Savarkar Sports Complex has already hosted events like Commonwealth Weightlifting and Asian Aquatics Championships.
The Khel Mahakumbh grassroots sports programme recorded a record 71.30 lakh participants in 2025, with a 'Mini Khel Mahakumbh' held in Surat in January 2026.
Ahmedabad is also assessing feasibility for a future Olympic bid (targeting 2036), separate from the confirmed 2030 Commonwealth Games.

sections.heading: Why It Matters
sections.body: This is a good example of the ANNOUNCED vs ONGOING vs COMPLETED distinction the exam wants: the 2030 host decision is already final (completed as a decision), but the actual Games and most of the infrastructure build-up remain ongoing through 2026 and beyond.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Ahmedabad will host the Centenary (2030) Commonwealth Games; through 2026 it is ramping up by hosting smaller international events and building sports infrastructure.
keyFacts: 2030 Commonwealth Games host: Ahmedabad (Amdavad), Gujarat — the Centenary edition.
India's second Commonwealth Games after New Delhi 2010.
Glasgow hosted the 2026 edition (concluded 2 August 2026) before the spotlight shifts to Ahmedabad.
Gujarat separately eyeing a future Olympic bid (target 2036).
commonConfusion: The 2030 Commonwealth Games (confirmed) and a possible 2036 Olympics bid (still exploratory) are two SEPARATE ambitions — don't merge them into one fact.

highYieldFacts: Ahmedabad 2030 = Centenary Commonwealth Games, India's second time hosting (after Delhi 2010).
commonTraps: Confusing the CONFIRMED 2030 Commonwealth Games host status with the still-EXPLORATORY 2036 Olympics ambition.
mustRemember: Glasgow hosts 2026; Ahmedabad hosts the Centenary 2030 edition.
